title: 31 Enterprise Sales Meetings for a Workflow Automation SaaS
challenge: A B2B workflow automation platform had a strong product but struggled to consistently reach operations leaders. Its outbound efforts were broad, resulting in low response rates and limited high-quality demos.
solution: Myntmore created industry-specific ICPs focused on operations, digital transformation and process improvement leaders. We reworked the founder's positioning and developed LinkedIn campaigns highlighting time savings, workflow inefficiencies and automation use cases.
